name: m3-crash-restore
description: M3 gate 2 after a crash, not a quit: three workspaces, a split in one and a long page scrolled to the bottom in another; once SessionStore's recovery file has settled (save interval 500 ms here, 15 s by default) the browser is SIGKILLed (no quit observers, no final save), and a start on the same profile brings back the workspaces in order, the active one, each one's tabs, the split and the scroll position. Crash recovery is the build's default (resume_from_crash on); Vimma's browser.startup.page = 3 would restore the session even without it. With both off it fails at the first check after the start. Back in main, G scrolls the long page to its bottom again before the kill: the personal workspace has one tab, so it draws no tab line (docs/specs/tab-line.md decision 3, "auto" by default since 20 Nov 2026), and the page, a row taller there, is a row short of its bottom when the line comes back.

steps.keys: p e r s o n a l enter
